{{Quote|I don't know what it does&mdash;that's the beauty of it!|Anonymous Chadra-Fan engineer|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />}}
'''Chadra-Fan''' {{Pronounced|Chăd'-rä-Făn}} were short, [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]]-like [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], usually no more than one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall, with [[Bat/Legends|bat]]-like faces. They hailed from the [[Water/Legends|watery]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chad/Legends|Chad]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Hyperlane_Scout_FDCR.png|thumb|left|200px|A Chadra-Fan hyperlane scout]]
Chadra-Fan had seven different senses&mdash;sight, touch, taste, sound, smell, [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] sight, and chemoreceptive smell&mdash;all of which were much more acute than [[Human/Legends|Human]] senses.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> They were usually no more than a meter tall, some depicted with plantigrade two-toed feet, while others seemed to have four-toed feet.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> The metabolism of Chadra-Fan was amazingly fast, allowing them to work almost constantly. They only slept in two hour naps during the day. Because of their metabolism, the average Chadra-Fan matured by age fifteen and rarely lived more than forty years.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

How Chadra-Fan perceive and respond to their fast-paced surroundings is due in part to their biology, not just their environmental
experiences. The Chadra-Fan's senses are strangely unique—in particular those of sight and smell. The species' large black eyes can see into the infrared spectrum of light, giving them a marked advantage at night and in poorly lit areas. In addition, their olfactory sense is remarkably distinctive, the result of two sets of nostrils that each serves a separate specific function. The outer pair detect water-soluble scents like most humanoid species, while their inner nostrils control Chadra-Fan's chemoreceptive sense of smell.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

Chadra-Fan had two [[Heart/Legends|hearts]], but would die in three days if one of the hearts failed.<ref name="Queen of the Empire" />

Chadra-Fan were covered from head to foot in fur. Their species evolved from [[Chadra-Fan precursor species|small, arboreal rodents]]. The two different sexes of Chadra-Fan were indistinguishable to other species, though the Chadra-Fan could readily tell the difference using their powerful sense of smell. If a male and a female Chadra-Fan were interested in one another, they released special pheromones that relayed their feelings. Chadra-Fan also had involuntary pheromones that conveyed information about their family line and created an aura of attractiveness. Other voluntary pheromones often conveyed a Chadra-Fan's state of emotion-anger, fear, or joy. Chadra-Fan even created more complex messages using their pheromones, though the pheromones when mixed sometimes caused confusion.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> They were unique in the fact that they had clear blood.<ref name="Queen of the Empire" />

The race were small but quick witted creatures that resembled rodents. Their combination of infrared sight, hypersensitive sense of smell as well as keen hearing made them physically and mentally perceptive beings.<ref name="Queen of the Empire" />

==Society and culture==
<div style="float:right">[[File:Chadra-Fan-TUR.png|thumb|180px|A Chadra-Fan pilot for [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]]]]</div>
Chadra-Fan culture was greatly affected by the tendency of hurricanes and tsunamis to wash away their bayou homes (as happened in [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], when a "Death-Wave" wiped out much of their civilization). As a result Chadra-Fan slept during the midday in their temporary dwelling that hung from [[cyperill tree]]s.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> They all had an instinctive fear of drowning in water. They regarded very few things as permanent, seeking only to enjoy themselves in the moment.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> Many Chadra-Fan that left their homeworld went to arid planets, in order to escape any chance of drowning.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

Chadra-Fan loved to tinker with mechanical devices, often disassembling and reassembling them into something completely different. Chadra-Fan living in [[The galaxy/Legends|the greater galaxy]] sometimes worked in industrial research, by creating unique devices which engineers of other species with more conventional talents attempted to duplicate.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> Their inventions were even considered collectible and pieces of art. Chadra-Fan constructed many of their creations individually, though they were capable of mass-production.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

The Chadra-Fan language relied on the ability of each Chadra-Fan to recognize differences in pitch. If a Chadra-Fan was tone deaf, he or she was unable to speak coherently. Their language also depended on the ability of each to understand pheromone messages.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

It was uncontroversial for Chadra-Fan to move about naked, at least at the during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At the time, many Chadra-Fan wore no [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] at all in public without drawing the attention of bystanders or disturbing them.<ref name="gal">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> In contrast, clothed Chadra-Fan were just as common throughout history, with many of them wearing more-or-less elaborate [[Robe/Legends|robes]].<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref><ref name="TNEGtAS" /><ref name="SWR 49">[[Republic 49|''Republic'' 49]]</ref>

===Society===
[[File:Kabe2.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]], a Chadra-Fan]]
The society of Chadra-Fan is divided into a clan structure in which every member was responsible for parenting the clan's children and a fact of life was that every household was open at any time. Leadership within the clan was a temporary role that was passed from one individual to another as the situation called for a particular expertise. Children were the centerpiece of a Chadra-Fan community, and only left when wed, however the new Chadra-Fan couple remained with the smaller clan so it was possible that a Chadra-Fan never left his or her home.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

Chadra-Fan, if left alone, suffered from strong depression that would kill them in a matter of weeks. Thus, Chadra-Fan were not very picky when it came to friends and preferred complete strangers to loneliness.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> Many Chadra-Fan were taken offworld as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], but they took this positively by thinking of it as a big adventure. They were also a jovial race, who almost always got on well with others. Only the most evil acts against them would make them think otherwise.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> Chadra-Fan were generally excellent team members and were extremely forgiving or so ignorant that they forgot any failings within a group. Chadra-Fan, thus, could be found with various criminals because they were so unobservant or accommodating.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

A deity called the [[Big Green Fish]] figured in Chadra-Fan religion.<ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>

==Chadra-Fan in the galaxy==
The Champ was a pazaak player on Nar Shaddaa during the First Jedi Purge who Meetra Surik was able to trick into beating to attract the attention of The Exchange.

[[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]] was an orphan taken in by the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Muftak/Legends|Muftak]] and a regular at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]].

[[Tekli]] was a Jedi apprenticed to [[Cilghal]]. She became a member of the [[Myrkr strike team]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. At the end of the war she became an Magister-in-training for the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] on [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]]. After a few years on Zonama Sekot, she left for the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] with other surviving members of the [[Myrkr strike team]] and temporarily was a [[Joiner]]. After treatments by Cilghal she decided to remain a Jedi.

[[Tili Qua]] was a member of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] in [[137 ABY]].
